name: Before the Divorce: My CEO Husband Can't Get Enough of Me
original_name: Before the Divorce: My CEO Husband Can't Get Enough of Me
overview:
After getting married, they didn't even know each other and even had a one-night stand.

Sophia was set up and had a one-night stand with Matthew. At the moment, Matthew does not realize Sophia is the wife he married three years ago. As the public relations manager, Sophia once again runs into Matthew at a business occasion. Matthew had a rather negative impression of Sophia at first, but after untangling the misunderstanding, Matthew started looking up to Sophia's professionalism. During their time together, Matthew eventually falls in love with Sophia, and at the same time, he thinks his unseen wedded wife is also having an affair, thus deciding to file for divorce. Eventually, Matthew realizes that Sophia is his wife, but everything is too late. Now he has to try everything he can to win her back.
